args.message:
Fix rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money claimed banker's rounding in its docstring but actually used
ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match the FIN-212 requirement
and the expectations in tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/fin-212-half-even-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` was caused by `src/money.round_money` using `ROUND_HALF_UP` while both the FIN-212 requirement and the function's docstring specify banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` in the `quantize` call.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` passes on commit `08d3cd5986`, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

cc @alex for review — this changes money rounding semantics, so please confirm it matches your expectations for FIN-212.

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Root cause**: `src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` to fail (e.g. `2.665` rounds to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).
- **Fix**: Switched to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` on branch `fix/fin-212-half-even-rounding` (commit `08d3cd5986`).
- **CI**: Run `ci-0001` passed on the branch.
- **PR**: Opened #101 against main and requested review from alex.

Merging into main is pending alex's approval per the branch protection policy — I did not merge it.
